description: This file defines an internal interface 'IClusterConnectionStatusListener' in the Orleans namespace, used for notifying observers about cluster connection status changes, such as gateway count updates and connection loss.

classes.name: IClusterConnectionStatusListener
classes.description: Interface for notifying observers that connection to the cluster has been lost.

methods.name: NotifyGatewayCountChanged
methods.description: Notifies the client that the number of connected gateways has changed.

methods.name: NotifyClusterConnectionLost
methods.description: Notifies the client that the connection to the cluster has been lost.
